title: Towards Training-free Automatic Proxy Discovery via Large Language Models for Mixed Precision Quantization
abstract: arXiv:2512.07419v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Mixed-Precision Quantization (MPQ) liberates Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) from the Out-Of-Memory (OOM) bottleneck and has garnered increasing research attention. However, conventional methods either rely on costly differentiable optimization search, which is neither efficient nor flexible, or learn a quantized DNN from a proxy (e.g., HAWQ) manually designed by human experts, which is labor-intensive and requires extensive expert knowledge. Can we design a proxy without involving any human experts or training? In this paper, we provide an affirmative answer by proposing a novel Large Language Model (LLM)-driven Training-free Automatic Proxy (dubbed TAP) discovery framework. It reforms the design paradigm of MPQ by utilizing LLMs and evolutionary search strategies to automatically find superior TAP tailored for MPQ. In addition, to bridge the gap between black-box LLMs and the challenging MPQ task, we introduce a lightweight Direct Pref

translated_title: 面向混合精度量化的基于大语言模型的无训练自动代理发现方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2512.07419v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：混合精度量化（MPQ）使深度神经网络（DNN）摆脱了内存溢出（OOM）瓶颈，因此获得了越来越多的研究关注。然而，传统方法要么依赖代价高昂的可微分优化搜索，既不高效也不灵活；要么从人工专家手动设计的代理（如HAWQ）中学习量化DNN，这既费时费力，又需要大量专家知识。我们能否在不涉及任何人类专家或训练的情况下设计出这样的代理？在本文中，我们给出了肯定的答案，提出了一种新颖的大语言模型（LLM）驱动的无训练自动代理（TAP）发现框架。该框架利用大语言模型和进化搜索策略，自动寻找为混合精度量化量身定制的优越TAP，从而革新了MPQ的设计范式。此外，为了弥合黑盒大语言模型与具有挑战性的MPQ任务之间的差距，我们引入了一种轻量级的直接偏好（Direct Pref）（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了由大语言模型驱动的无训练自动代理发现框架TAP，利用大语言模型与进化搜索策略自动为混合精度量化设计优越的量化代理，无需人工专家参与或任何训练过程。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes TAP, an LLM-driven training-free framework that leverages large language models and evolutionary search to automatically discover superior quantization proxies for mixed-precision quantization, eliminating the need for human experts or any training.
